implementation.text: Shared regular13px Liberation Sans/FreeType face; unkerned hinted single advances, including11. Date uses regional en-US formatting, while the sample meeting caption uses UI localization. Recorded caption clip rectangles differ at the leading Cyrillic glyph. No glyph bitmap is stored.
implementation.fragments: 255 scalar color values record small thumb/track caps in both directions, four invariant axis-join RGB pixels and the scrollbar corner. Reopening the field at a different editor position reproduces the axis fragment; no whole-widget bitmap or comparison mask is used.
implementation.sourceSemantics: Native export removes Font, BackColor and BorderColor from PlannerField. Explicit12pt/16pt-bold inputs keep the same internal13px regular paint. ReadOnly/Enabled do not alter the recorded planner surface. Requested and canonical XML are both retained. No BSL executes. Typed inspector/applicability and style inheritance remain open.
implementation.clock: Production uses current local Date and a one-second repaint timer, also updating on model/resize/zoom. Test Date proxies exist only in owned isolated webviews, using each native opening timestamp in Europe/Moscow. The clock-tick case repaints without changing XML. Exact native clock sampling cadence is unaccepted after an initial boundary sample differed by one pixel row.
implementation.lifecycle: The Solid outer control and selected identity survive dirty XML, dimensions and ignored font/color changes, floating updates and reattachment. One existing lazy regular face is reused; no dependency or WASM changes.
implementation.nativeCapture: Resizing a native preview splitter can clear its planner demo; those blank captures are not accepted. Fresh close/reopen captures preserve the demonstration. The full600x493 field uses two visible native viewports with an exactly matching overlap and complete bottom border, not offscreen pixels.
implementation.testEnvironment: Main and active floating isolated IDE windows use stock fullscreen so complete control/frame borders fit. Native and installed viewer captures compare all pixels, including fonts, scrollbar edges and clock line.
